title: Department of Veterans Affairs: Phase 56N Verified Remediation Decision
summary: GAO lists recommendation 28 Closed-Implemented after determining that VA's 2025 AI use-case inventory included the required information and aligned with instructions. Phase 56N decision: Publish the exact recommendation closure as a bounded inventory-governance result; do not substitute it for the open iFAMS access-control rail.
key_findings: Status period: GAO assessment of VA's 2025 AI inventory in March 2026.
Evidence state: Partially Closed to Partially Closed.
Continuation rule: Reopen when VA OIG closes a named iFAMS recommendation, publishes the FY 2025 FISMA result, or GAO revises the recommendation 28 status.
why_it_matters: The record adds exact implementation, non-closure, component, or portfolio evidence while keeping recommendation states and operational outcomes distinct.
ftfn_relevance: Separates recommendation implementation from performance, service, mission, safety, and readiness outcomes.
Keeps source owner, record identity, status period, limitation, and continuation rule attached.
evidence_limits: Inventory completeness does not establish model performance, clinical safety, mission benefit, cybersecurity effectiveness, or closure of unrelated VA recommendations.
The separate iFAMS recommendation closures, the FY 2025 FISMA result, named-system controls, and measured clinical or mission outcomes.
No entity ranking, composite, productivity, readiness, value, or causal claim is supported.
